title: 第十一章 仇恨的种子第十二章 炼药师协会
content_zh:
“真的假的？我儿子是十一灵脉，绝等资质！”杜娴满面红光，自豪道。
“别高兴得太早……”楚鸿道，“天舒，口说无凭，你如何证明自己是十一灵脉呢？”
楚鸿心里还是有些疑虑，他还想要确认确认，自家儿子到底有没有十一灵脉。
“这简单，爹你往后退，接我一拳就知道了。”楚天舒自信道。
“接你一拳？”楚鸿点点头，立刻将结界扩大数倍，然后从中央退至边缘处。杜娴亦是如此。
楚天舒催动人王经，调动灵泽内储存的灵气，体内气血翻涌，肌肉猛地绷直，灵气在四肢与脖颈中游走。体表泛出红光来——那是独属于人王一脉的血肉灵力！
“灵力外放！这……这怎么可能！”杜娴失声惊呼，美眸中充满了骇然。
楚鸿亦是瞳孔猛缩，心中掀起了惊涛骇浪。灵力外放，这是只有达到脉络境才能掌握的手段。可他的儿子，明明连灵泽境二级都未突破！这完全违背了修炼界的常识！
就在他们震惊之际，楚天舒动了！
人王经九秘之——力字秘！
没有任何花哨的招式，只是简简单单地向前踏出一步，拧腰、送肩、挥拳！动作流畅而暴力，将全身的力量，连同那赤红色的血肉灵力，尽数灌注于这一拳之中！
“轰——！”
拳锋所过之处，空气被硬生生打爆，发出沉闷的音爆声！一道凝练的赤红拳罡脱手而出，如同出膛的炮弹，裹挟着一往无前的气势，悍然轰向楚鸿。
“嗡——！”
一声剧烈的能量震荡在结界内回荡。楚鸿身前的护体灵力剧烈波动起来，表面甚至出现了细微的裂痕。
这一拳的威力，绝对远超寻常灵泽境一级，甚至堪比灵泽境中期修士的全力一击！更重要的是，这力量的来源，并非单纯的灵气，更像是……气血与灵气完美融合后的产物！
楚天舒吐出一口浊气，刚才那一拳已经消耗了他的全部灵力。
“如何？”楚天舒笑道。
楚鸿眼中爆发出前所未有的精光，他死死抓住楚天舒的双肩，力道大得让楚天舒都微微皱眉。
“好！好！好！”他连说三个好字，每一个字都比前一个更重，更沉，“十一条！哈哈哈！天不亡我楚鸿这一脉！天不亡我儿！”

他猛地转头，看向同样处于巨大冲击中的杜娴，声音压得极低，却带着不容置疑的铁血意味：“此事，绝不可外传！若是让其他两脉，亦或是王家、秦家得知，天舒就危险了。”
南元城内三大家族鼎立，矿脉资源基本由三家族平分。近年来矿脉开采枯竭，灵石产量日益减少，楚、王、秦三家的资源争夺、摩擦也愈加严重。彼此之间视对方为敌，暗杀天才的事时有发生。
杜娴神情严肃道：“嗯。”
木秀于林，风必摧之，如此妖孽的天赋定会引发他人的嫉妒。
在夫妇二人心里，半年之后无论结果如何已经不重要了。
他目光重新回到楚天舒身上，谨慎道：“天舒，此事你千万不能告与他人！包括天清。”
“我知道。”楚天舒道。
接着他又说道：“爹，抢生灵石是因为我……”
“没事，他们技不如人还能怪你不成？”楚鸿拍了拍楚天舒肩膀，“胆子大一点，尽管去做，出事有我们扛着呢。”
content_en:
"Really or not? My son has eleven spiritual veins and is extremely qualified!" Du Xian said proudly with a red face.
"Don't be too happy too soon..." Chu Hong said, "Tian Shu, your words are unfounded, how can you prove that you have eleven spiritual veins?"
Chu Hong still had some doubts in his heart. He also wanted to confirm whether his son had eleven spiritual veins.
"It's simple. Dad, just step back and receive my punch." Chu Tianshu said confidently.
"Punch you?" Chu Hong nodded, immediately expanded the barrier several times, and then retreated from the center to the edge. The same is true for Du Xian.
Chu Tianshu stimulated the Human King Sutra and mobilized the spiritual energy stored in Lingze. The energy and blood in the body surged, the muscles suddenly tensed, and the spiritual energy traveled in the limbs and neck. The body surface glows with red light - that is the flesh and blood spiritual power that belongs exclusively to the human king lineage!
"Spiritual power is released! This...how is this possible!" Du Xian exclaimed, her beautiful eyes filled with horror.
Chu Hong's pupils shrank sharply, and a turmoil arose in his heart. Exuding spiritual power is a method that can only be mastered by reaching the Vein Realm. But his son has clearly not even broken through to the second level of Lingze Realm! This completely goes against the common sense in the cultivation world!
Just when they were shocked, Chu Tianshu moved!
The Nine Secrets of the Human King Sutra - the Secret of Li Zi!
There are no fancy moves, just a simple step forward, twisting the waist, shouldering, and punching! The movements are smooth and violent, pouring all the strength of the whole body, together with the red flesh and blood spiritual power, into this punch!
"Boom——!"
Wherever the fist passed, the air was violently blasted, making a dull sonic boom! A condensed red fist shot out of his hand, like a cannonball from the barrel, carrying an indomitable momentum and blasting towards Chu Hong.
“Buzz——!”
A violent energy shock echoed within the barrier. The protective spiritual power in front of Chu Hong fluctuated violently, and even slight cracks appeared on the surface.
The power of this punch is definitely far beyond the ordinary level one of Lingze Realm, and even comparable to the full blow of a monk in the middle stage of Lingze Realm! More importantly, the source of this power is not simply aura, but more like... the product of the perfect fusion of qi, blood and aura!
Chu Tianshu let out a breath of turbid air. The punch just now had consumed all his spiritual energy.
"How?" Chu Tianshu smiled.
Chu Hong's eyes burst into unprecedented light, and he grabbed Chu Tianshu's shoulders with such force that Chu Tianshu frowned slightly.
"Okay! Okay! Okay!" He said three good words in a row, each word heavier than the previous one, "Eleven! Hahaha! God will not destroy my Chu Hong lineage! God will not destroy my son!"
He turned his head suddenly and looked at Du Xian, who was also in the midst of a huge impact. His voice was extremely low, but with an unmistakable iron-blooded tone: "This matter must not be spread to outsiders! If the other two families, or the Wang family and the Qin family know about it, Tianshu will be in danger."
There are three major families in Nanyuan City, and the mineral resources are basically equally divided among the three families. In recent years, the mining of mineral veins has been exhausted, the output of spiritual stones has been decreasing day by day, and the resource competition and friction between the Chu, Wang, and Qin families have become more and more serious. They regard each other as enemies, and assassinations of geniuses often occur.
Du Xian looked serious and said: "Yes."
Even if a tree is beautiful in the forest, the wind will destroy it. Such a monster's talent will definitely arouse the jealousy of others.
In the minds of the couple, no matter what the result is after half a year, it no longer matters.
His eyes returned to Chu Tianshu, and he said cautiously: "Tianshu, you must not tell anyone else about this! Including Tianqing."
"I know." Chu Tianshu said.
Then he said: "Dad, the reason for grabbing the living stone is because of me..."
"It's okay. Can I blame you if they are not as skilled as others?" Chu Hong patted Chu Tianshu on the shoulder, "Be brave and just go ahead and do it. If anything happens, we will take care of it."
